# DrDreams

> Studying medicine in the Philippines, explained for Indian students: the degree and how long it takes, what five and a half years cost, which colleges India's NMC lists, the documents and visa, the exams after graduation, and what daily life is like in Cebu, Manila and Davao.

DrDreams is a reference site written by Dr. Nitz (Nitish), who graduated from the Doctor of Medicine programme at Southwestern University in Cebu in 2025 and cleared FMGE on the first attempt. Each page states whether the detail is first hand, from graduates and students, or from a primary source (NMC notices, WDOMS, the college's own fee sheet), and carries the month it was last reviewed.

Fees change every intake. The four colleges with published 2026-2027 sheets (Gullas, DMSF, Jose Maria and Brokenshire) reproduce them with the exchange rate and the date. Southwestern and Perpetual are on request. Every price page tells you what to confirm in writing before you pay.

Every page below has a Markdown twin at the same path with a `.md` extension and YAML front matter. Text is licensed CC BY 4.0 with attribution to drdreams.in. Last updated 22 November 2026.

## Guides

- [Study MBBS in the Philippines: Fees, Colleges, NMC Rules (2027)](https://drdreams.in/index.md): What MBBS in the Philippines costs, which colleges India's NMC lists, the documents, the visa steps and what FMGE takes. Checked against NMC notices.
- [MBBS in the Philippines: Complete Guide for Indians (2027)](https://drdreams.in/mbbs-in-philippines.md): Degree, duration, NMC recognition, eligibility, costs and the year-by-year reality, from a 2025 graduate of Southwestern University, Cebu.
- [MBBS in the Philippines: 18 Questions Students Ask (2027)](https://drdreams.in/faq.md): Cost, duration, NMC rules, NEET, safety, documents, colleges open for the 2027 intake and what happens after graduation, answered in plain language.
- [MBBS in the Philippines Fees 2027: What Five Years Cost](https://drdreams.in/fees-and-cost.md): What MBBS in the Philippines costs for 2027: tuition, hostel, food, flights, visa renewals and FMGE prep, with the published college fee sheets side by side.
- [MBBS in the Philippines Without NEET: How the BSBio Route Works](https://drdreams.in/without-neet.md): The honest version of studying medicine in the Philippines without clearing NEET: what BSBio does, how long it adds, what NMC actually requires, and the risks.
- [Philippines Student Visa and Admission Process: Step by Step](https://drdreams.in/admission-process.md): The full admission process: documents, acceptance letter, student visa, housing and arrival, plus the four things that go wrong and who does each step.
- [Documents Required for MBBS in the Philippines (2027 Checklist)](https://drdreams.in/documents-required.md): The full document list for admission and the student visa: marksheets, NEET scorecard, passport, birth certificate, police clearance and financial proof.
- [NMC Public Notice March 2026: 54-Month Rule and CRMI Explained](https://drdreams.in/mci-rules.md): The NMC public notice of 5 March 2026 explained: 54-month course, 12-month internship at the same university, CRMI, WDOMS verification, and the official PDF.
- [FMGE and NExT for Philippines Graduates: A Study Plan by Year](https://drdreams.in/fmge-next.md): What FMGE and NExT involve, the twelve month Indian internship after the MD, and a year-by-year study plan from a graduate who cleared it on the first attempt.
- [Is MBBS in the Philippines Valid in India? NMC Rules (2027)](https://drdreams.in/is-mbbs-in-philippines-valid-in-india.md): Yes, if the college is on India's NMC list when you enrol and graduate. The degree, FMGE or NExT, the twelve month internship, registration and the traps.
- [After MBBS in the Philippines: FMGE, Internship, PG and Jobs](https://drdreams.in/after-mbbs-in-philippines.md): What happens after the MD: FMGE or NExT, the twelve month Indian internship, state registration, NEET-PG, jobs in India and licensing options abroad.
- [Cebu vs Manila vs Davao for MBBS: Which City to Choose (2027)](https://drdreams.in/cebu-vs-manila-vs-davao.md): Compare Cebu, Manila and Davao for Indian medical students: living cost, safety, Indian food, traffic, hospitals, typhoons, flights and the colleges in each.
- [MBBS in the Philippines vs Russia, China, Georgia and Nepal](https://drdreams.in/mbbs-in-philippines-vs-other-countries.md): A practical comparison for Indian students: language, clinical access, cost, recognition, food, distance and who each destination suits.
- [Student Life in the Philippines for Indian Students (2027)](https://drdreams.in/student-life.md): Student life in the Philippines for Indian medical students: food, rent, safety, transport, weather, homesickness and the first month in Cebu, Manila or Davao.
- [Study Resources for Indian Medical Students in the Philippines](https://drdreams.in/study-resources.md): A study hub for students already in a Philippine medical college: the year-wise subject map, a weekly system, FMGE integration, and the notes being added.
- [Medical Colleges in the Philippines: 6 Compared (2027)](https://drdreams.in/colleges.md): Six NMC-listed medical colleges in Cebu, Manila and Davao compared on cost, batch size, hospital exposure, FMGE coaching and Indian food.
- [MBBS in the Philippines Glossary: NMC, FMGE, NExT, CRMI](https://drdreams.in/glossary.md): Plain definitions of the terms Indian medical students meet: NMC, FMGE, NExT, FMGL, CRMI, WDOMS, BSBio, CHED, apostille, 9F visa and more.

## Colleges

- [GCM Gullas College of Medicine: Fees, Review, Cebu (2027)](https://drdreams.in/colleges/gcm-gullas.md): GCM Gullas in Cebu reviewed: 2026-2027 fees, who it suits, the large batch, basic hostel, on-campus FMGE coaching, and how to verify the college.
- [Southwestern University Cebu: MBBS Review (2027)](https://drdreams.in/colleges/southwestern.md): Southwestern University in Cebu, reviewed by a 2025 graduate: hospital rotations, a smaller Indian batch, no in-house FMGE coaching, and the admin office.
- [University of Perpetual Help: MBBS Review, Manila (2027)](https://drdreams.in/colleges/perpetual.md): University of Perpetual Help in Las Piñas reviewed: the largest Indian student community, FMGE coaching, Indian food and the Manila traffic.
- [DMSF Davao: Fees, Review and NMC Status (2027)](https://drdreams.in/colleges/dmsf.md): Davao Medical School Foundation reviewed: the 3D anatomy lab, heavy patient flow, FMGE coaching by Indian doctors, higher fees and the distance from home.
- [Brokenshire College Davao: Fees, Review, NMC Status (2027)](https://drdreams.in/colleges/brokenshire.md): Brokenshire College in Davao reviewed: small batches, faculty who know your name, a smaller attached hospital, FMGE coaching and a cadaver lab.
- [Jose Maria College Davao: Fees, Review, NMC Status (2027)](https://drdreams.in/colleges/jmc.md): Jose Maria College in Davao reviewed: the lowest total cost of the six, medical missions for community health, basic facilities and no Indian food culture.
